## Set up 

```{r 1. Project Setup, message = FALSE}
# Loading packages and checking working directory
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
here()
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
```

## Read in Data

```{r 1. Project Data, message = FALSE}
# Event Data
california_events <- read_sf(here("./Data/Raw/California_events.shp"))
dim(california_events)
```

## Editing Variable Classes

```{r 1. Project Data, message = FALSE}
# Changing ig_date variable from character to date
california_events$ig_date <- ymd(california_events$ig_date)

# Changing last_date variable from from character to date
california_events$last_date <- ymd(california_events$last_date)

# Changing mx_grw_dte variable from character to date
california_events$mx_grw_dte <- ymd(california_events$mx_grw_dte)

# Changing lc_name variable from character to factor
california_events$lc_name <- as.factor(california_events$lc_name)

# Viewing the factor levels of land cover types
levels(california_events$lc_name)
# There aren't any n/a or unclassified types that need to be removed

# Changing eco_name variable from character to factor
california_events$eco_name <- as.factor(california_events$eco_name)
```

## Selecting Variables

```{r 1. Project Data, message = FALSE}
#Selecting variables that we want to include in the processed dataset

california_events_processed <- select(california_events, 
                                      id, ig_date, ig_day, ig_month, ig_year, 
                                      last_date, event_dur, tot_ar_km2, fsr_km2_dy,
                                      mx_grw_km2, mn_grw_km2, mu_grw_km2, mx_grw_dte,
                                      lc_code, lc_mode, lc_name, lc_desc, lc_type,
                                      eco_mode, eco_type, eco_name, tot_perim)

#view(california_events_processed)
```

#Saving the Processed Data

```{r 1. Project Data, message = FALSE}
# Saving the processed dataset in the Processed Data folder
write.csv(california_events_processed,
          row.names = FALSE,
          file = here("Data/Processed"))
```
